title: Gazeta Wyborcza: ownership and control
summary: Gazeta Wyborcza is a Polish national news daily with local editions and the Wyborcza.pl website. Its publisher, Wyborcza sp. z o.o., is wholly owned by listed company Agora S.A. Agora-Holding holds 11.60% of Agora’s capital but 35.36% of its voting rights, alongside special nomination rights. Other major shareholders include OFE PZU Złota Jesień and MDIF Media Holdings I, LLC.

edges.description: Other shareholders include several pension funds and investment-fund portfolios. Their disclosed positions have differing observation dates, so no single current remainder percentage is asserted. Fund-manager labels are not treated as beneficial ownership by those managers.

gaps: Research cutoff: 2026-09-18. Searches for recent sales found no supported change to the publisher–Agora chain; this does not exclude undisclosed transactions.
The latest opened dated major-shareholder observation is 2026-08-12. Some corporate website shareholder tables retain older figures and labels; the 2026 interim report takes precedence.
The interim report gives PZU’s capital holding as 17.44%, while the secondary table gives 17.45% for the same share count. The graph preserves the primary report’s figure.
Smaller holdings have mixed reporting dates. They remain within the aggregate remainder rather than being presented as a synchronized current shareholder register.
Ownership above Agora-Holding, MDIF Media Holdings I and the pension fund is outside the three-relationship limit. No ultimate individual controller is established.
The publisher disclosure lists executives as beneficial owners but supplies no personal equity percentages. No personal ownership edges were inferred from those listings.
The full current statute and a current official company-register extract were not obtained. The nomination-rights edge is limited to the right evidenced by the June 2026 issuer announcement.
Undated masthead and media-services disclosures have null observation dates. Wikidata identifiers were not verified.
